verdicts.reason: Reproduced at 1280: the Search region (searchbox, Search, Filters) is shown above the Tools grid, but the ARIA tree lists the Tools results before the Search region, and the 5th Tab press (after the brand and 3 nav links) lands on the first result link 'Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries', not on the search field.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced at 1280: sessions appear as Wed 28 alone on the top row, then Sat 24 to Sat 10 left to right below it. The ARIA/DOM order runs Sat 10 to Wed 28. After clicking Sat 10, pressing ArrowRight twice selected Wed 14 and then Sat 17, so the selection moved leftward on screen.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced after opening Filters at 1280: the hint 'Show tools you could pick up on or after this day.' is shown under the Available from date input. The selector #from:not([aria-describedby]) matched a visible element, and #from[aria-describedby] did not match within 3 s.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced: with 'Pick up Saturday 17 October' on the card, Sat 10 and Wed 14 are offered as radios under 'You can collect at any of these sessions'. Choosing Sat 10 and pressing Continue left the page on basket.html with no visible message or new ARIA alert.
verdicts.note: The silent no-op on Continue is a separate, possibly more serious problem (no error feedback; H1/H9) worth its own candidate. I did not compare it with a valid session because my Sat 17 probe failed on an ambiguous locator (probe 102). The H4 criterion fits poorly; H5 (error prevention) suits offering incompatible sessions better.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced at 375x900 dark (viewport capture): opening Loan length shows the listbox (One week, Two weeks per ARIA), but only 'One week' is visible above the fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar. After ArrowDown, the focused 'Two weeks' option's focus ring is cut off by the bar at about y=828.

The 1280 'day-chosen' evidence ('Monday 12 hidden under the bar') comes from a full-page capture, where fixed bars are misplaced, so it was not verified; drop it or re-probe it with a viewport capture. A focused element being obscured also fits WCAG 2.4.11 (Focus Not Obscured).

The locations and bbox were copied from F-0156 (footer band) and do not point at this problem; re-anchor them to the confirm form and done 'What happens next' box. A narrow measure for forms is a common deliberate choice, so the rater should judge it as taste.
